description: This file defines a Python class for configuring and interacting with Amazon Bedrock imported models that utilize the OpenAI Chat Completions API format. It handles URL construction, request signing, and request transformation specific to Bedrock's environment, extending base classes for OpenAI format and AWS request signing.

classes.name: AmazonBedrockOpenAIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Bedrock imported models using the OpenAI Chat Completion API format. Handles URL construction, request signing, and request transformation specific to AWS Bedrock's environment. Extends OpenAIGPTConfig for OpenAI parameters and BaseAWSLLM for AWS-specific functionality.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the configuration, inheriting from OpenAIGPTConfig and BaseAWSLLM.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns a string identifier indicating the LLM provider, here 'bedrock'.

methods.name: str _get_openai_model_id(self, model: str)
methods.description: Extracts the model ID from the model string by removing the 'bedrock/openai/' prefix.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete invocation URL for the Bedrock endpoint, incorporating model ID and stream parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[bytes]] sign_request( self, headers: dict, optional_params: dict, request_data: dict, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, fake_stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Signs the request using AWS Signature Version 4 by delegating to an inherited method.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms request messages to the OpenAI format, removing AWS-specific parameters and handling stream parameters separately.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and returns headers for the environment, content to be used for Bedrock without Bearer token.

methods.name: BedrockError get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates and returns a BedrockError object based on error message and status code.
